name: biome
title_zh: MR 里新增的 Biome 告警
tagline_zh: 别人 lint 只报全量错，它只盯你这次 MR 引入的新告警。合并前扫一眼，别让旧账混进新账。
tagline_en: Others lint everything; it flags only warnings your MR adds. See exactly what you introduced before merge—no old.
desc_en: Use when user asks to lint with Biome, check lint warnings introduced in an MR/branch, run `lint:ref`, or read/triage large Biome diagnostic output in the Gramax project. Triggers on keywords like biome, lint, lint:ref, warnings, lint gate.
why_zh: diff 级告警归因，把 lint:ref 输出按改动行切分，只留你碰过的代码。旧债不背，新账不漏。
why_en: Diff-aware attribution: splits lint:ref output by changed lines, keeping only code you touched. No inherited debt, no missed new.
limit_zh: 只认 Gramax 仓库的 Biome 配置与 lint:ref 输出格式；其他项目或自定义规则需先适配。不修代码。
limit_en: Only for Gramax repo's Biome config & lint:ref output; other setups need adaptation. It locates and attributes, never fixes—output ends at a warning.
title_en: Biome warnings new in your MR, listed one by one
